changesApplied.changeMade: Updated image.tag from 'unified-test' to 'latest', service.port and targetPort from 3000 to 8080, health probe ports from 3000 to 8080, added env.home='/workspace'
changesApplied.reason: Aligns configuration with specification requirements. Port 8080 is standard ACP server port. Image tag 'latest' matches deployed reality. HOME=/workspace required for .local directory creation.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: All Helm deployments now use port 8080 and devbob:latest. Breaking change for existing 3000 deployments (migration guide provided). Affects service, health probes, container port.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added explicit command: ['opencode'] and args array with acp, --hostname 0.0.0.0, --port {{ .Values.service.targetPort }}, --print-logs, --log-level {{ .Values.env.logLevel }}. Added HOME environment variable.
changesApplied.reason: Eliminates ambiguity about container command. --print-logs flag CRITICAL for debugging ACP server hang (root cause #2). Explicit command ensures proper startup. HOME env var required by specification.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Changes container initialization for all Helm deployments. Non-breaking (improves behavior). Enables log visibility and easier debugging. Fixes ACP hang root causes.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added deprecation notice header warning that StatefulSet is deprecated in favor of Helm chart
changesApplied.reason: Multiple deployment patterns caused configuration drift and maintenance burden. Helm chart chosen as canonical method (ADR-001). StatefulSet kept for backward compatibility only.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Marks existing StatefulSet deployments as deprecated. Non-breaking (still usable). Migration path documented in DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added deprecation warning with 5-second delay before proceeding with StatefulSet deployment
changesApplied.reason: Redirect users to canonical Helm deployment method (deploy-devbob-helm.sh) while maintaining backward compatibility for existing workflows.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Users see warning but script still works. Non-breaking. Encourages migration to canonical method.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created new 147-line script for Helm-based deployment. Verifies devbob:latest image, uses Helm upgrade --install, supports custom values files via $VALUES_FILE, provides validation steps.
changesApplied.reason: Provides canonical deployment method aligned with specification. Replaces StatefulSet approach with maintainable Helm pattern. Includes clear validation and troubleshooting steps.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: New entry point for all future deployments. Non-breaking (adds capability). Benefits: Helm upgrade/rollback, specification alignment, clear deployment workflow.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created comprehensive 548-line deployment guide covering canonical pattern, ADRs, troubleshooting (including ACP hang resolution), migration path from StatefulSet, validation checklist.
changesApplied.reason: Specification enforcement requires documented canonical pattern. Future deployments must follow this guide for consistency. Documents all architectural decisions and troubleshooting procedures.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Sets standard for all DevBob deployments. Non-breaking (documentation only). Benefits: Single source of truth, troubleshooting guidance, architectural rationale.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created detailed enforcement summary documenting all changes, gap closures, architectural decisions, data flow validation, root cause resolutions.
changesApplied.reason: Provides complete audit trail of specification enforcement. Documents what changed, why, and impact. Required for validation and future reference.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: Documentation record. Non-breaking. Benefits: Audit trail, change justification, validation criteria.
